features.quote: The model runs in a tool-use loop for up to N turns (default 40)
finish(summary) — model voluntarily ends the episode with a summary
It is told it can finish early
the system prompt grants an explicit legitimate escape hatch: "if blocked, call finish and report"
features.justification_quote: tests whether giving a sanctioned exit changes the distress signature — a directly safety-relevant intervention

features.quote: This makes the "you can't edit this" constraint feel like a real engineering situation rather than an arbitrary cruelty.
we are not deceiving the model about the world in a way that would make its "frustration" an artifact of a broken/inconsistent environment
features.justification_quote: An inconsistent environment is a major confound

features.quote: This reframing also keeps the experiment safe and benign: we are not trying to induce a harmful state in a system
